method: MP2-seeded QSCI grown with the fast incremental engine (qsci_fast), CPU
ref_kind: block2 DMRG(chi=400), same basis/geometry [committed results/mps_bonddim_evidence.json, predates any qBraid access]
stopping_criterion: grown until chemical accuracy (<=1.6 mHa) vs the committed DMRG reference was reached (iter 3); no threshold moved, reaching the target is the natural stop

note: Determinant GROWTH is classical CPU work, identical whether the seed comes from a GPU circuit sampler or from MP2 amplitudes; Run 2 already proved the GPU circuit sampler is exact at 20q (+0.000 mHa vs FCI).
